topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I walked into the new office space, my steps slow across the polished floor. Each piece of furniture seemed more solid than the last, as if to anchor me with their weight. The walls, painted a stark white, reflected more light than I'm used to, making the room feel both vast and somehow confining. Colleagues offered smiles that felt as thin as the paper my previous tasks were printed on. I fiddled with the edge of a folder, the smoothness of it slipping through my fingers. Settling into my new desk, I rearranged the items multiple times, finding comfort in the methodical order amidst a sea of unfamiliar faces.
